items.title: Chester Jones Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: I think Joe René was a soft drummer. Yeah, yeah. Joe René. I think he was a soft drummer.

ctx.x: You know something I've often wondered is, who were the drummers that could really swing but play very soft? Some bands get down real low and the drummers are really swinging, but not loud. I think Joseph Frasier was the one. I didn't even hear him. But I think that's probably the way he used to do it. You can tell the way he's doing it now. It can really come down. Some drummers it's... I never did hear him, but I think he got that ability.
I think Joe René was a soft drummer. Yeah, yeah. Joe René. I think he was a soft drummer.
Yeah, well some guys can play so well and have a lot of feeling and still they don't have to play fast or loud.
